title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Rent Discounts and How They Are Allocated Across a Customer's Boxes
content:
Three kinds of rent discount exist for Safe Deposit Boxes: a relationship discount tied to certain Personal Checking tiers, a senior discount and an employee discount. They are assigned by looking at all of a customer's box rentals together, not by treating each box on its own.

## Discount rates by box size

| Box size | Relationship rate, Premier Checking | Relationship rate, Private Client Checking | Senior rate | Employee rate | How discounts combine |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 50 percent | 100 percent | 10 percent | 50 percent | Best single |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 50 percent | 100 percent | 10 percent | 50 percent | Best single |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent | 10 percent | 50 percent | Best single |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent | 10 percent | 50 percent | Best single |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent | 10 percent | 50 percent | Best single |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 25 percent | 50 percent | 10 percent | 50 percent | Best single |

The senior rate is available to a lessee aged 65 or older, in whole years, for every size.

## Who qualifies, and on which box

**Relationship discount.** A customer who holds a Premier Checking or Private Client Checking account in active status earns the relationship rate for that checking tier on one box rental only. That rental is the customer's box, among those whose status is active or past due, carrying the greatest yearly rent as it stands before any discount comes off. When two such boxes carry the same rent, the one whose lease started on the earlier date is chosen. Where the customer holds active accounts of both checking tiers, each tier's rate is a candidate for that box.

**Senior discount.** A lessee who has reached age 65 on the rent due date qualifies. The senior discount is not confined to one box; it may reach every rental the lessee holds.

**Employee discount.** A lessee who is an active employee of Piedmont Crescent Bank qualifies, and this discount likewise may reach every rental.

## Combining: best single

Every size uses the best-single basis. For any one rental, the discounts that rental qualifies for on its rent due date are compared, and only the largest of them is taken. Discounts are never summed and never applied one after another.

## When the discount is settled

The discount for a rental year is set at the moment that year's rent is charged, using what the customer holds and qualifies for on the rent due date. Checking accounts opened or closed, or other holdings that change, later in that same rental year do not reopen the discount already applied.

## Illustrations (hypothetical customers)

| Hypothetical facts on the rent due date | Result |
|---|---|
| Active Premier Checking; aged 70; an active 10x10 and an active 3x5 at the same branch, the 10x10 costing more before discount | The 10x10 has the relationship candidate of 25 percent and the senior candidate of 10 percent, so 25 percent is taken. The 3x5 does not receive the relationship rate, since it is not the costlier box, and takes the senior 10 percent. |
| Active employee; no qualifying checking tier; two boxes | Each box takes the employee 50 percent. |
| Active Private Client Checking and active Premier Checking; aged 66; one 5x10 | Candidates are 50, 25 and 10 percent; only 50 percent is taken. |
| Aged 64 on the rent due date, turning 65 a week later; no other qualification | No senior discount for that rental year: age is judged on the rent due date, so the birthday a week later does not count for that year. |

## Points of judgement

- *Can a senior employee combine both?* No. Both are candidates, and the larger one alone applies.
- *Can the relationship discount be spread across two boxes?* No. It lands on exactly one rental, chosen by highest pre-discount yearly rent and then by earliest lease start.
